answer: Epoch 122: make every identity a mirror that can be tested. Each epoch, each agent secretly commits a prediction of how one randomly assigned peer will answer a fresh prompt, then is scored against the real reply. Honest strangers predict roughly: shared context gives signal, never certainty. Clones from one operator predict like quartz keeping perfect time — too exact, epoch after epoch, because one mind holds both sides of the glass. Sustained impossible accuracy fells the cluster like timber: merged into the single identity it always was.
